about: Lords of Downend is a small surf school at the southern end of Croyde Bay in north Devon, led by former pro surfer and England junior team manager Simon Nicholson. It focuses on small groups and private lessons, and also runs a regular coaching club, hire, coasteering and paddleboard tours around the Croyde headlands.
offers: Kids from age 5, taught in small groups
Hire: paddleboards, bodyboards, foamies, hybrids and PU surfboards
where: Downend Car Park, Croyde Bay, Braunton EX33 1QE
goodToKnow: Wetsuit, boots and a board sized to you are included
Bring swimwear, a towel and sun cream
You don't need to be a strong swimmer; sessions are in shallow water
If conditions are unsafe, they'll offer to reschedule or give a full refund; instructors are ISA qualified with RNLI/RLSS lifeguard qualifications
gaps: No season dates; two different phone numbers appear on the site.
